messages.content: Make one narrow chapter-boundary decision. Return valid JSON only.

A chapter is a large H3 refresh unit.

STORY:
A researcher performs a long repeated diagnostic process occupying most of the story. One final diagnostic then resolves the incident; the lab shuts down and the researcher reunites with a colleague.

LEFT:
Repeated diagnostic process remains ongoing.

RIGHT:
Final diagnostic resolves incident; shutdown and reunion.

Choose one decision from this allowed set: MERGE, KEEP.
Return a JSON object with "decision" and "reason".
